Headline: #34 South Michigan buses Temporary Reroute near 130th/Indiana
ShortDescription: #34 South Michigan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to police activity near 130th/Indiana.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

#34 South Michigan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions:

Southbound buses will operate via  Michigan, 115th, Bishop Ford to I-94 expressway, 130th East, Eberhart and then will resume their normal route.

Northbound buses will operate via Eberhart, 131st, Ellis, 133rd place, Langley, 131st, Eberhart, 130th, Bishop Ford to I-94 expressway, 115th, Michigan and then resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to police activity near 130th/Indiana .
